purpose: Archive the measured object-indexing candidate with every gain, regression, and failed validation version.

decision.decision: Preserve as a measured experimental indexing candidate; do not replace the primary checkout or claim an overall performance win. Continue addressing fallback costs and compiler barriers.
limitations: Five focused integer cases improve, but some fallback cases, startup, full-suite wall time, and RSS regress.
The retained comparison includes intervening changes; it is not the isolated indexing effect.
All 24 authoritative results match CPython, but the separate semantic oracle preserves an existing staticmethod class-subscription mismatch.
No universal superiority, energy, parallel scaling, portability, or controlled build-time claim.

packing: Deterministic archives preserve original member paths and bytes. Executable binaries, build/frozen caches, generated standard-library dependency trees, and the live exporter log are excluded. All source identities, validation records, failed test-harness and readiness versions, codegen, methods, complete census coverage, all raw semantic evidence, and all four timing datasets are retained. Final complete EXPORT.txt is added after export closes.

checkpoint_filter.purpose: Make cache-free checkpoint copies while preserving the original local archives.
checkpoint_filter.note: Only generated bytecode/cache members are omitted. Every remaining source, test, input, result, failure, and method retains its original bytes. The original manifest is inside the filtered archive. Historical reports and EXPORT logs describe the original archive; use this checkpoint manifest for the committed copies.
